title: High-Temperature Increasing Propagation of Chaos and its breakdown for the Hopfield Model
summary: We analyze increasing propagation of chaos in the high temperature regime of a disordered mean-field model, the Hopfield model. We show that for $β 0$. At the ciritcal temperature we show that, for $M$ finite, there is increasing propagation of chaos, for $k=o(\sqrt N)$, while we have breakdown of propagation of chaos for $k=c \sqrt N$, for a $c>0$. All these reulst hold in probability in the disorder.
